original.statement: When -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, Loki frontend v2 now sends pure Protobuf requests via the scheduler to the querier instead of wrapping them.

corrected.statement: When -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, Loki frontend v2 no longer wraps requests. It now sends pure Protobuf through the scheduler to the querier.

decision.reason: [ev-3f7dccc9a7e0] describes a change in how frontend v2 sends requests over the wire through the scheduler to the querier: they are no longer wrapped and are sent as pure Protobuf. The value of `-frontend.encoding` did not change. `=protobuf` is only the setting under which the new wire behaviour applies, so it belongs in applicability. That makes protocol-behavior the right subject family. Setting after="protobuf" on the flag misstates this as a new flag value, so I left before/after out because the text gives no literal values for them.
